title: Every turn that writes gets a before picture drawn before its write, never one older than the site's last write, and shared writes are checked on other pages
steps: S1: the previous turn (or another conversation) wrote after the picture.
S2: no Browser-tab picture; the turn writes.
S3: the drawing does not finish in time.
S4: a comment turn writes a shared header.
S5: a write the door asks about first.
S6: a hold whose turn already spent 4,990 ms of the 5 s default, with a drawing that never ends.
expect: S1: no before from that picture, no comparison.
S2: the first write is held until its page is drawn, then sent; the check runs.
S3: the write goes at the budget; the late picture is never the before.
S4: its page and home are drawn before the write; one comparison of both.
S6: the hold gives up after about 10 ms; with 5,000 ms spent nothing is drawn.
evidence: Review 20/10/2026: the before could predate the last write (the unasked-change verdict would then undo a requested change); turns with no Browser tab had no check; other pages were never looked at
fence: Before pictures are taken before the write and after the site's last write

tests: 🔒 the previous turn wrote after the picture and the tab never said changed: no "before", no comparison
🔒 another conversation wrote the site after the picture: no "before" from it
🔒 no Browser-tab picture: the first write is held until its page is drawn, then sent, and the check runs
🔒 a draw that does not finish in time: the write is sent at the budget, the late picture is never the before
🔒 a comment turn writing a shared header: its page and home drawn before the write, one comparison of both
🔒 a delete or a hide without the customer’s yes is not held; with confirm:true it is
🔒 the 5 s budget is shared by every hold of the turn, and is the default
